### Step 1: Create the namespace `loop-test`
I will create the namespace `loop-test` first. After that, I will verify its creation.

### Step 2: Deploy the nginx app
I will deploy a single-replica nginx app called `web-server` in the `loop-test` namespace. After deployment, I will verify the pod's status.

### Step 3: Expose the app with a ClusterIP service
I will expose the `web-server` deployment with a ClusterIP service on port 80. After exposing, I will verify that the service has endpoints.

### Step 4: Clean up resources
I will delete the namespace `loop-test`, which will clean up all resources within it. After deletion, I will verify that the namespace no longer exists.

---

4. Namespace `loop-test` cleaned up and verified as deleted.
